mutations.name: a dense chapter keeps its items
kills: explainer eval calibrate queue under --max-density, drops a dense chapter's cold and l1 items and a dense script's rubric items

mutations.name: the round number is always 1
kills: explainer eval calibrate queue orders the clearest video first, then the pairs, and writes the round number and minutes per kind of item

mutations.name: a bench row's eval_version is dropped
kills: explainer eval calibrate queue queues each question once, from the judge's own latest verdict, and names the config and run it came from
explainer eval calibrate agreement pools rounds given as repeated --key and --feedback, naming them, and leaves a judge's older version out

mutations.name: unpaired keys and feedback are accepted
kills: explainer eval calibrate agreement refuses keys and feedback files that do not pair up, or a round given twice

mutations.name: a pooled record does not name its rounds
kills: explainer eval calibrate agreement pools rounds given as repeated --key and --feedback, naming them, and leaves a judge's older version out
